main_text.p: Fut. 1. ἴω & εἶ, ibo, obsoletum, pro quo praesens usurpatur. Futur. med. εἶμαι [?] ibo, veniam.
Singularis 2 comp. ἀπἰῃ abi, ἐπἰῃ invade, ἐπίξῃ perfequere. Dicitur & εἶ: hinc ἔξι exi, διέξι pervade.
Aorist. 1. εἶσα inufitatum: hinc tamen 3 dual. εἰσάτην: poeticé ἐισάτην, (& in medio aoristo ἐισαάτην) jverunt duo. 3 plur. εἶσαν (unde comp. ἀνῆσαν ascenderunt) poeticé ἤσαν.
Aorist. 2. ἴον, ἴες, ἴε, &c. ab εἶω: hinc ἔνε iniit. Est etiam hujus temporis εἴον, εἴες, & Atticé ἦον.
Horistic. εἶκα inufitatu: unde Horistic. 4 εἴκδν. Atticé ἤκδν.
Fut. perf. 2 ἴω, ἴῃς, ἴῃ, (Ionicé ἴῃσι) ive-

page.notes: Greek forms are read from a small, faint scan; accents and breathings are uncertain and marked [?] where doubtful. The Greek in the first paragraph and the aorist forms could not be confirmed letter by letter.
